The winged fish hovers, gently flapping its feathered wings, its body bobbing.
The winged fish glides forward, beating its feathered wings in a steady rhythm.
The winged fish pulls its wings back and tucks its body low, ready to leap, and holds.
The winged fish leaps up high with its wings spread, then dives down steeply head first, then levels out.
The winged fish jerks back in the air, wings flaring, then recovers.
The winged fish falls to the ground, its wings folding, and lies on its side.
